Measured on 2026-10-25 with comprs 2.3.0 (`fb6a968`), Node.js v24.21.0, pako 3.0.2 and fflate 0.8.3, on AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor × 4 (linux/x64), in [this run](https://github.com/derodero24/comprs/actions/runs/40203478609) of the Bench Report workflow, on a GitHub-hosted runner (ubuntu24, image 20261023.334.3). Settings, the same for every library in a table: gzip level 6 · deflate level 6 · brotli quality 6, lgwin 22 · brotli quality 11, lgwin 22 · zstd level 3 · streams: gzip level 6, zstd level 3 · cross-algorithm: each format's default settings (lz4 has no levels). Speeds are MB/s of uncompressed data (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes), from the median time of a call. Every library decompresses the output of comprs, so that only the decoders differ, except in the cross-algorithm table, where each format decompresses its own. The compression ratio is the input size divided by the output size.
